title: Just-in-time credential request instead of a failure
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. When a mission needs a cloud model and no key exists: ask once on a tty, otherwise emit a machine-readable 'credential needed' record and a distinct exit code so agents and CI can supply it, never a stack trace. Tests zc_jit_credentials_*.
